item.title: Intermittent failures on Comparables [resolved]
item.description: We haven't observed any errors after our fix. The incident is resolved.

item.title: Offers search API degraded [resolved]
item.description: We are aware of an issue affecting offers search API and are investigating. Updates will be posted here as we progress

item.title: Database capacity incident affecting Service Availability [resolved]
item.description:
All services have returned to normal operation and are stable.
We have identified and paused the processes that contributed to the incident, and the platform has fully recovered. We will continue to monitor the environment closely to ensure stability.
A detailed postmortem, including root cause analysis, impact assessment, and follow-up actions, will be shared as soon as it is available.
Thank you for your patience while we worked to resolve the issue.

item.title: Valuation API Outage [resolved]
item.description: Summary On 13 May 2025, between 10:30 and 11:05 CEST, we experienced an incident affecting our API services. The majority of users were unable to access the Valuation API during this window, and elevated response latency was observed across all API endpoints. Full service was restored at 11:05 CEST. Root Cause We identified a bottleneck in a component on the critical path of our infrastructure. Under load, this component became a limiting factor and degraded service availability and performance. Remediation We are actively implementing improvements to the affected component to increase its scalability and prevent recurrence. We will continue to monitor the situation closely following these changes. Monitoring & Transparency<
